approval_basis.source: current user standing request to execute the captured work pack
approval_basis.scope: SWU-TSGR-004 exact three declared shared-path updates
approval_basis.regenerability_treatment: deterministic staged updates reduce decision cost only while baseline conflict detection, owner admission, public boundary, no publication, and consequence-free application remain proven

obligations.summary: Execute exactly SWU-TSGR-004 structured executor launch-or-join.
Bind the passing SWU-TSGR-003 terminal result and joined closeout receipt.
Use structured argv, cwd, timeout, and bounded output without shell interpolation.
Validate executor receipt identity and terminal write ordering before execution-received.
Distinguish implementation execution failure from governance failure.

constraints: Execute exactly one SWU in this Task Session.
Update only the three admitted shared runner paths.
Block if any live shared target changes from its preflight digest before apply.
Do not implement SWU-TSGR-005 or later behavior.
Do not update generated mirrors, publish, promote, commit, push, or deploy.
Persist the terminal Task Session result only after live validation and allowed-write reconciliation.

done_criteria.criterion: Executor receipt identity and write order validate.
Execution failure remains distinct from governance failure.
No reconciliation or live apply occurs.
